roadmap.title: True Ending and broad cleanup
roadmap.description: Use the first 13-shift run for the strict $250 True Ending while buying the full arsenal and killing the three Hunt enemies. Protect personal income by avoiding human kills.

roadmap.title: Fast Hunt and Grave Decision
roadmap.description: On a new run, prepare Shift 1 for a sub-30-second Hunt, then continue through Shift 12 and call Clyde to obtain Grave Decision.

roadmap.title: Empty Home ending
roadmap.description: On the third run, keep Clyde alive, refuse to call him after Shift 12, and complete Shift 13 with less than $250 in personal funds.

achievements.summary: Kill any store @npc{customer}; either a human or a doppelganger satisfies the first-customer kill.

guide.context: Killing a real human reduces personal income needed for the True Ending. The low-risk route is to identify a doppelganger, finish its transaction, and eliminate it afterward.

steps.text: During a shift, identify a @enemy{doppelganger customer} and complete that customer's transaction.
Use any available weapon to kill the doppelganger before the shift ends.

achievements.summary: Trigger a @mechanic{Hunt} by serving a doppelganger or reaching a Blood Moon, then survive the complete nightly assault.

guide.context: Serving a doppelganger can start a Hunt before the first scripted Blood Moon, so this achievement does not require waiting for a particular late shift.

steps.text: Serve a doppelganger during a shift, or continue Story Mode until the first @mechanic{Blood Moon} begins.
Use traps, boards, and weapons to stay alive until the Hunt ends and normal shift play resumes.

achievements.summary: During a @mechanic{Hunt}, find and kill one crawling @enemy{Shrieking Doll} accompanying the main entity.

guide.context: Shrieking Dolls are the small, crawling, baby-like enemies in an assault. They can be killed with normal weapons.

steps.text: Trigger or reach a @mechanic{Hunt} and watch for the smaller enemies moving near the main entity.
Identify a crawling @enemy{Shrieking Doll} and shoot or strike it until it dies.

achievements.summary: Place a @item{Bear Trap} in a @enemy{Demented}'s path during a Hunt, look away so it moves, and let the trap kill it.

guide.context: A Demented behaves like a weeping angel: direct observation freezes it, while breaking line of sight lets it advance.

steps.text: During a @mechanic{Hunt}, identify the humanoid @enemy{Demented} that stops moving while you look directly at it.
Place a @item{Bear Trap} on the floor between the Demented and your position.
Look away from the Demented so it walks forward and enters the Bear Trap.

achievements.summary: From @mechanic{Shift 9 onward}, leave a jack-in-the-box unwound until its @enemy{Marionette} attacks, then kill the Marionette.

guide.context: Marionettes are unavailable before Shift 9. Rewinding their jack-in-the-box prevents the enemy from emerging, so intentionally allow one box to expire.

steps.text: Progress Story Mode to @mechanic{Shift 9 or later} and enter a Hunt containing a jack-in-the-box.
Do not wind that jack-in-the-box; wait until the @enemy{Marionette} emerges and begins attacking.
Use any available weapon to damage the Marionette until it dies.

achievements.summary: On a new save, trigger the first Shift 1 @mechanic{Hunt} and kill its entity within @mechanic{30 seconds}.

guide.context: The first Hunt on a fresh save is the lightest version of the assault. Preparing Bear Traps and loaded guns before serving the doppelganger prevents setup time from consuming the 30-second window.

steps.text: Start a new save and prepare @item{Bear Traps} and loaded guns during Shift 1.
Identify a doppelganger, deliberately complete its transaction, and position yourself at the prepared defenses before the Hunt begins.
Immediately focus every trap and weapon on the Hunt entity and finish the complete assault within @mechanic{30 seconds}.

achievements.description: Purchase all Melee Weapons & Fill out the Weapons Arsenal
achievements.summary: On one save, buy the @item{Brick}, @item{Baseball Bat}, @item{Sledgehammer}, and every one of the @mechanic{4 ranged-weapon slots}.

guide.context: The default Pistol does not need to be purchased. Store-shopping money is separate from personal surgery funds, so arsenal purchases do not reduce the $250 True Ending reserve.

steps.text: On the same save file, purchase the @item{Brick}, @item{Baseball Bat}, and @item{Sledgehammer}.
Purchase every available ranged weapon until all @mechanic{4 ranged arsenal slots} covering the SMGs, Shotguns, and Flamethrower are filled.
Check that the complete weapon arsenal is filled; the default Pistol requires no purchase.

achievements.description: Let Sheriff Clyde die so your pet survives.
achievements.summary: Keep @npc{Sheriff Clyde} alive, choose @mechanic{Call Clyde} after Shift 12, then complete Shift 13 so the pet survives and Clyde dies.

guide.context: Calling Clyde guarantees that the pet's surgery is funded regardless of the player's personal balance, but Clyde dies after helping.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Sheriff Clyde} alive through the first 12 shifts.
After Shift 12, select the literal choice @mechanic{Call Clyde}.
Complete Shift 13 and continue through the veterinarian outcome in which the pet survives and Clyde dies.

achievements.description: Let your pet die while Sheriff Clyde survives.
achievements.summary: Keep @npc{Sheriff Clyde} alive, choose @mechanic{Don't Call Clyde} after Shift 12, and finish Shift 13 below @mechanic{$250 in personal funds}.

guide.context: This ending checks the personal balance after the final Shift 13 payout. Store revenue and store-shopping money do not count toward the $250 surgery bill.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Sheriff Clyde} alive through the first 12 shifts and keep personal funds low enough to remain below $250 after one final payout.
After Shift 12, select the literal choice @mechanic{Don't Call Clyde}.
Complete Shift 13 and reach the veterinarian with less than @mechanic{$250 in personal funds} so Clyde survives but the pet's surgery cannot be paid.

achievements.description: Keep both your pet and Sheriff Clyde alive.
achievements.summary: Keep @npc{Sheriff Clyde} alive, choose @mechanic{Don't Call Clyde} after Shift 12, and finish Shift 13 with at least @mechanic{$250 in personal funds}.

guide.context: The veterinarian checks personal funds only after the final Shift 13 payout; store revenue and the shopping balance cannot pay for surgery. Killing real humans reduces personal income, while store purchases do not touch the surgery reserve.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Sheriff Clyde} alive throughout the Story Mode run and avoid killing real human customers.
After the surgery warning following Shift 10, preserve personal earnings until the displayed personal-funds total can reach @mechanic{$250} with the final payout.
After Shift 12, select the literal choice @mechanic{Don't Call Clyde}.
Complete Shift 13, receive its payout, and pay the veterinarian with at least @mechanic{$250 in personal funds} so both the pet and Clyde survive.
